description: This Java class 'TbCoapClientState' manages the state of a CoAP client within the Thingsboard platform, including device credentials, transport configuration, session info, and notification handling.

classes.name: TbCoapClientState
classes.description: Manages the state and configuration of a CoAP client, including device credentials, session info, and queued notifications.

methods.name: TbCoapClientState
methods.description: Constructor initializing the client state with a device ID.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the client state with device credentials and sets profile and power parameters.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Acquires the lock for thread-safe operations.

methods.name: updateLastUplinkTime
methods.description: Updates the timestamp of the last uplink and resets firstEdrxDownlink flag if newer.

methods.name: checkFirstDownlink
methods.description: Checks and resets the firstEdrxDownlink flag.

methods.name: onDeviceUpdate
methods.description: Updates profile and transport configuration parameters based on device data.

methods.name: addQueuedNotification
methods.description: Adds or merges attribute update notifications into the missedAttributeUpdates queue.

methods.name: getAndClearMissedUpdates
methods.description: Retrieves and clears the queued missed attribute updates.
